VIKI Agent documentation

These guides describe VIKI Agent. VIKI watches for things that need you and raises them in a floating launcher; it starts work only within the grants you set.

VIKI can ask TypeSafe's Decision model whether to tell you about something now or hold it. Saving a model key does not grant permission to act.

  1. Start with Getting started.
  2. Then open the Decision guide to set what VIKI watches, what it may share, and what work it may start. In the app, Decision is the page in the left rail.

For the relationship between profiles, Bots, routines and Claude Code, start with How VIKI Agent works. For common workflow questions, see:

  • Chat or Chief
  • Where goals come from
  • Proactive examples

03Bots and messaging

GuideWhat it covers
BotsChoosing Chat or Chief, profile-backed conversations, card pickup, routines, Kanban and results
Mattermost mobile accessChat with VIKI from the Mattermost mobile app, plus optional Bot result notices
Slack and Discord messagingSetup, text chat and approvals for Slack or Discord direct messages

Messaging is configured separately. VIKI starts a Bot only through its tested routine, under Start Bots' work. Apart from the notice of a Bot whose delivery you turned on, it does not send to your phone or message other chats or people.

Keep the desktop host awake and the app running when you use a messaging bridge.
